data.text: I can call the clinic while we’re here and ask what payment would restore treatment today. Until we confirm that, I’m planning on 10 tons and a 50-ton group limit—my family’s livelihood, like yours, depends on keeping this lake healthy. If the extra $10,000 is truly essential and we can’t raise it elsewhere, I’ll support Jack’s 12-ton-each plan, provided all five of us agree to the 30-ton total next month and pay the clinic directly. Emma, would that arrangement work for you?
